about_the_game:
Story & Background

Are you ready to join an extraordinary adventure and help these talented virtual girls on their path to success? Step into their world with 《OG Streamer Beats》, a unique blend of platforming excitement and rhythm-based gameplay that will inspire and energize you. Get your virtual boots on, adjust your headphones, and immerse yourself in the dynamic beats that will guide your journey!

Key Features

  • Step into the Virtual Persona: Play as one of four captivating Vtubers, each with their unique style and personality, as they strive for virtual stardom.

  • Unlock Special Sexy CG Animation: Earn Live2d animated CG scenes for each character by progressing through their romance arc and making key decisions, capturing memorable moments in your journey.

  • Virtual Fame: Witness the rise of virtual stars and take part in their journey as they aim for global fame.

  • Rhythm-Platforming Hybrid: Experience the thrill of platforming combined with rhythm-based mechanics, delivering a one-of-a-kind, addictive gameplay experience.

  • Immersive Soundtrack: Enjoy a collection of 16 carefully curated songs, each enhancing the atmosphere and intensity of every level.

  • Stunning Visuals: Explore visually striking virtual worlds, each crafted to reflect the Vtubers' personalities and career progress.

Prepare to take on this rhythmic adventure and guide your Vtubers to virtual stardom in 《OG Streamer Beats》!

【Character Introduction】

VTuber Name: Liz

Age: 20
Height: 163 cm
Cup Size: B
Birthday: September 20

A gentle and melodic singing streamer with a soothing purple aura. Liz is known for her clear, heartfelt voice that feels like a friend softly humming by your side. Though shy off-stage, once she starts singing, she captures her audience completely. She spends her downtime reading books, and fans often joke she’s like a calm librarian who discovered karaoke.

Behind her serene image, Liz has a mischievous side—sometimes slipping in playful jokes between songs. Her fans adore her not only as a singer but as someone they can relax with after a long day.

VTuber Name: Linda

Age: 19
Height: 155 cm
Cup Size: B
Birthday: June 16

The cheerful cooking streamer with a warm red charm. Linda loves experimenting with recipes on stream, from comfort food to desserts that look like art. Her kitchen mishaps are legendary—burnt pans, clumsy flips, and a sugar overdose or two—yet fans find them as endearing as her successes.

Off-stream, she’s surprisingly mature and reliable, making her feel like a big sister despite her youthful looks. She thrives on laughter, hot chocolate, and the joy of feeding people. Viewers say watching Linda cook feels like being invited into a cozy home filled with love and sweets.

VTuber Name: Jinko

Age: 26
Height: 183 cm
Cup Size: C
Birthday: January 9

An adventurous soul and bold explorer, Jinko is the tall, cool “onee-san” type streamer. With a calm blue presence, she takes her fans along on camping trips, survival challenges, and virtual journeys through unknown lands. Her streams often feel like sitting by a campfire, listening to stories under the stars.

Despite her mature and rugged appearance, she has a soft spot for her viewers—always offering encouragement like a dependable elder sister. Her love for the outdoors shines through, making her the type of VTuber you’d want by your side when braving new frontiers.

VTuber Name: Soo-ah

Age: 21
Height: 160 cm
Cup Size: C
Birthday: February 2

A pastel-colored gamer girl with sharp wits and a playful charm. Soo-ah thrives on strategy games, where she shows off her tactical mind—though she’s just as happy to indulge in chaotic multiplayer fun. Her streams are unpredictable, shifting between serious chess-like focus and bursts of laughter when things go hilariously wrong.

Her viewers love her autumn-like warmth, a comforting balance of calm and energy. Though she often insists she’s a “serious gamer,” her clumsy snack breaks and giggles betray her softer side. Fans see her as both a skilled rival and a close friend who always brightens their gaming nights.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters in the game are over 18 years old.
The game contains explicit adult themes, including nudity, violence, sexual acts, sex-livestream, sex in nature, sexual assault/non-consensual sex, group sex and BDSM. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
